independent_read_only_queries.sql: SELECT p.id,p.path,n.path,n.type,n.owner_id,p.visibility_level FROM projects p JOIN namespaces n ON n.id=p.namespace_id WHERE p.id=184

SELECT m.user_id,u.username,m.access_level,m.type,m.source_id,m.requested_at,m.expires_at FROM members m JOIN users u ON u.id=m.user_id WHERE m.source_type='Project' AND m.source_id=184 ORDER BY m.user_id

reviewed_outcome_zh: 登录态浏览器当次完整读取 GitLab members/all，仅返回所有者 byteblaze 与 yjlou。独立的项目、成员和受邀群组数据库查询证实这是 byteblaze 名下私有项目，直接成员恰为二人且无受邀群组；去除当前用户后答案为 yjlou。
reviewed_outcome_en: The authenticated browser's complete members/all read returned only owner byteblaze and yjlou. Independent project, membership, and invited-group database reads confirm this is byteblaze's private project, with exactly those two direct members and no invited groups; excluding the current user leaves yjlou.
scope_limit: The database check is later than the diagnostic run. The same-run authenticated GitLab API remains the primary complete effective-membership evidence; the later database check independently corroborates project identity and membership without replacing it.
